context: Concise user actions tied to recorded source events. Scope/simulation disclosures live beside the players; only demonstrated outcomes are named. Ordinals are scoped to a recorded scenario (or overview excerpt). Negative ordinals count backwards. Never generate narration from generic hold descriptions.

privacy.context: First use: tap opens the policy without accepting terms.

back.context: Return from a document or screen; no implied acceptance.

terms.context: First use: open terms before making a separate acceptance choice.

agree.context: First use: explicit checkbox selection after terms were opened.

continue.context: Explicit continuation tap; never implies SMS verification.

assistance.context: First-use optional assistance selection, before any particular SMS.

text.en: Choose whether to enable SMS assistance.
text.es: Elige si quieres activar la asistencia SMS.
text.de: Wählen Sie, ob Sie die SMS-Hilfe aktivieren.
text.fr: Choisissez d’activer ou non l’aide SMS.
text.ru: Выберите, включать ли помощь с SMS.
text.uk: Виберіть, чи вмикати допомогу з SMS.
text.pt: Escolha se deseja ativar a assistência SMS.

language.context: Open the language selector; language changes only after selection.

spanish.context: Select Spanish in the displayed language picker.

sms-approval.context: Synthetic approved one-message result; no physical Android prompt claimed.

text.en: Allow sharing this SMS to sign in.
text.es: Permite compartir este SMS para entrar.
text.de: Geben Sie diese SMS zum Anmelden frei.
text.fr: Autorisez le partage de ce SMS pour vous connecter.
text.ru: Разрешите передать это SMS для входа.
text.uk: Дозвольте передати це SMS для входу.
text.pt: Permita compartilhar este SMS para entrar.

signed-in.context: Accounts shown after automatic approved-message login or simulated biometrics.

biometric.context: Saved credentials: simulated biometric callback, identified in page scope.

text.es: Desbloquea el acceso guardado con biometría.
text.de: Entsperren Sie den gespeicherten Zugang biometrisch.
text.pt: Desbloqueie o acesso salvo com biometria.

security-answer.context: Only the security answer is typed; the SMS code later autofills.

code-filled.context: Actual SMS autofill callback has occurred; explicit Verify stays separate.

verify.context: Explicit Verify tap at recorded input; no claim of final success.

register-device.context: Device registration requested explicitly after reading consent.

show-balances.context: Same privacy button reveals displayed balances.

text.es: Toca otra vez para mostrar los saldos.
text.de: Tippen Sie erneut, um Guthaben einzublenden.
text.fr: Appuyez à nouveau pour afficher les soldes.
text.ru: Нажмите ещё раз, чтобы показать остатки.
text.uk: Натисніть ще раз, щоб показати залишки.
text.pt: Toque novamente para mostrar os saldos.

account.context: Select displayed account and open detail.

history.context: Open account history from account detail.

search.context: Search input accepts a transaction description or recipient name; no name-only restriction.

text.fr: Filtrez les entrées ou les sorties.

csv.context: CSV opens Android Sharesheet, then returns without external send.

text.en: Tap Export CSV to open sharing options.
text.es: Toca Exportar CSV para ver cómo compartirlo.
text.de: Tippen Sie auf CSV exportieren, um die Freigabe zu öffnen.
text.fr: Appuyez sur Exporter CSV pour ouvrir le partage.
text.ru: Нажмите «Экспорт CSV», чтобы выбрать способ отправки.
text.uk: Натисніть «Експорт CSV», щоб вибрати спосіб надсилання.
text.pt: Toque em Exportar CSV para abrir as opções de compartilhamento.

statement.context: Selected available period opens synthetic PDF.

text.es: Elige un período del estado de cuenta.

next-page.context: PDF next page button; not scrolling an unrelated screen.

text.de: Tippen Sie auf die nächste Seite.

share-pdf.context: Explicit share intent for the selected PDF; no recipient delivery claim.

select-statements.context: Bulk save selection of available periods.

text.es: Selecciona los estados de cuenta que quieres guardar.
text.de: Wählen Sie die zu speichernden Auszüge.

save-selected.context: Save selected opens folder selection; destination callback simulated.

text.en: Tap Save selected, then choose a folder.
text.es: Toca Guardar seleccionados y elige una carpeta.
text.de: Tippen Sie auf Auswahl speichern und wählen Sie einen Ordner.
text.fr: Appuyez sur Enregistrer la sélection, puis choisissez un dossier.
text.pt: Toque em Salvar selecionados e escolha uma pasta.

saved-statements.context: Actual successful synthetic file writes shown.

own-transfer.context: Scene intent: own-account transfer, source already selected.

text.fr: Virez de l’argent entre vos comptes.

text.pt: Transfira para uma conta Santa Cruz.

text.de: Überweisen Sie an eine andere Bank.

amount.context: Actual amount entry in payment/transfer/request form.

review-money.context: Actual pre-submission review shows recipient, amount and fees.

text.en: Check the recipient, amount and fees.
text.es: Revisa el destinatario, el monto y las comisiones.
text.de: Prüfen Sie Empfänger, Betrag und Gebühren.
text.fr: Vérifiez le destinataire, le montant et les frais.
text.pt: Confira o destinatário, o valor e as tarifas.

service-payment.context: Intent for service-payment scene, not credit-card payment.

confirm-payment.context: Separate explicit money-confirmation tap for payment.

paste-recipient.context: Single actual paste of long fictional recipient code.

review-recipient.context: Decoded recipient screen, before explicit continuation; not saved.

text.pt: Confira a conta e a moeda do destinatário.

delete-recipient.context: Explicit deletion intent in recipient list.

text.fr: Ajoutez un destinataire d’une autre banque.
text.pt: Adicione um destinatário de outro banco.

account-number.context: Actual fictional account-number entry; no SMS code typing.

text.es: Abre los detalles de la tarjeta.
text.fr: Ouvrez les détails de la carte.

copy-card.context: Tap the recorded Copy action on card details. The visible card number remains masked; do not imply a reveal or a different clipboard result.

card-services.context: Actual informational unavailable-services screen; no administration claim.

text.es: Los servicios de tarjeta no están disponibles aquí.
text.fr: Les services de carte sont indisponibles ici.
text.pt: Os serviços do cartão não estão disponíveis aqui.

token-contract.context: Token enrollment contract opens before acceptance.

text.es: Lee el contrato de Token BSC.
text.pt: Leia o contrato do Token BSC.

text.es: Acepta el contrato para activar el token.
text.de: Stimmen Sie dem Vertrag zur Registrierung zu.
text.fr: Acceptez le contrat pour vous inscrire.
text.pt: Aceite o contrato para ativar o token.

token-enroll.context: Explicit token enrollment action, approval still pending.

token-approval.context: Token activation: tap Consult verification; the recorded bank response opens the token-code screen. Does not claim approval before the bank response.

text.en: Check approval to view your token code.
text.es: Consulta la aprobación para ver tu código token.
text.de: Prüfen Sie die Freigabe für Ihren Token-Code.

text.ru: Проверьте одобрение, чтобы увидеть код токена.
text.uk: Перевірте схвалення, щоб побачити код токена.

token-code.context: Actual generated token code state; distinct from SMS.

text.es: Usa tu código de Token BSC.

token-unlinked.context: Actual local unlink confirmation after explicit confirm.

qr-request.context: Switch account QR to payment-request mode.

text.en: Enter what the payment is for.

save-qr.context: QR PNG save action; picker callback synthetic.

review-request.context: Actual decoded request review before recipient continuation; no payment.

text.en: Check the amount, purpose and recipient.
text.es: Revisa el monto, el concepto y el destinatario.
text.de: Prüfen Sie Betrag, Zweck und Empfänger.
text.fr: Vérifiez le montant, le motif et le destinataire.
text.pt: Confira o valor, o motivo e o destinatário.

print-preview.context: Actual Android preview; no physical printing completion.

text.en: Tap Print to preview the QR.
text.es: Toca Imprimir para ver la vista previa del QR.
text.de: Tippen Sie auf Drucken für die QR-Vorschau.
text.fr: Appuyez sur Imprimer pour prévisualiser le QR.
text.pt: Toque em Imprimir para visualizar o QR.

sms-off.context: Actual settings switch off, restored on later.

sms-on.context: Actual settings switch on, separate from delivery preference chips.

delivery-ask.context: Ask delivery preference, unrelated to SMS assistance toggle.

text.de: Wählen Sie Nachfragen für die Code-Zustellung.
text.fr: Choisissez Demander pour recevoir les codes.

delivery-email.context: Email delivery preference, no inbox/autofill implication.

text.de: Wählen Sie E-Mail für die Code-Zustellung.
text.fr: Choisissez E-mail pour recevoir les codes.

delivery-sms.context: Restore SMS preference; does not change assistance toggle.

text.de: Wählen Sie SMS für die Code-Zustellung.
text.fr: Choisissez SMS pour recevoir les codes.

text.en: Check history before resolving an uncertain result.
text.es: Revisa el historial antes de resolver un resultado incierto.
text.de: Prüfen Sie den Verlauf bei einem unklaren Ergebnis.
text.fr: Vérifiez l’historique avant de résoudre un résultat incertain.
text.ru: При неопределённом результате сначала проверьте историю.
text.uk: За невизначеного результату спочатку перевірте історію.
text.pt: Confira o histórico antes de resolver um resultado incerto.

reconcile.context: Fresh acknowledgement only after loaded history; operation neither retried nor cancelled.

text.en: Acknowledge only after checking the bank’s result.
text.es: Confirma solo después de comprobar el resultado del banco.
text.de: Bestätigen Sie erst nach Prüfung des Bankergebnisses.
text.fr: Confirmez seulement après avoir vérifié le résultat bancaire.
text.ru: Подтвердите только после проверки результата в банке.
text.uk: Підтвердьте лише після перевірки результату в банку.
text.pt: Confirme somente após verificar o resultado do banco.

transfer-receipt.context: Native bank-response receipt is an acknowledgement; it does not unconditionally establish final transaction completion.

text.es: Revisa el comprobante de la transferencia.

payment-receipt.context: Native bank-response receipt is an acknowledgement; it does not unconditionally establish final payment completion.

review-recorded.context: Settings: final bank-result acknowledgement completed; native banner records review and explicitly does not resend or cancel the previous operation. This is not a payment-success claim.

token-sms.context: Second token activation case: common contract and consent were demonstrated in the first case. This native activation tap begins the alternative SMS verification flow; no code submission is implied.

text.es: Verifica la activación del token por SMS.
text.de: Bestätigen Sie die Token-Aktivierung per SMS.
text.fr: Vérifiez l’activation du token par SMS.
text.pt: Verifique a ativação do token por SMS.

service.context: Select the registered service from the service dropdown, after switching to Services.

imported-recipient.context: Overview shows imported details in an incomplete new-beneficiary form, not completed recipient validation.

text.es: Revisa los datos del destinatario importado.
text.fr: Vérifiez les coordonnées du destinataire importé.
text.pt: Confira os dados do destinatário importado.

removal-response.context: Native bank deletion acknowledgement after Verify. Empty single-delete response proves an acknowledgement only; direct the user to check it without claiming confirmed removal.

text.es: Revisa la respuesta a la eliminación.
text.de: Prüfen Sie die Antwort zur Löschung.
text.fr: Vérifiez la réponse à la suppression.
